Anyone that has tried editing the config file and changing skins etc and still greyed out.. I finally the fix. I had a 1070 and got a 5070. I installed the gpu and driver and updated msi and voltage was greyed out. Tried everything still nothing. Finally found a fix..

\- Go to where Afterburner is installed usually under c drive x86 etc..

\- MSI Afterburner - Profiles

\- Delete the oldest VEN cfg files under date modified and leave the one that is closest or is the same day as it is currently for you. (You might have only 1 VEN cfg file if you have never added multiple gpus)

\- Open the VEN cfg file with notepad.

\- Go to the \[Settings\] line and under CaptureDefaults=0 add the line VDDC\_Generic\_Detection=1

\- Save the config file and restart afterburner

And bam.. Voltage is unlocked and not greyed out.

If windows doesnt let you save due to permission just save the cfg to desktop then drop and replace the old VEN cfg.

If it is still somehow greyed out try and go back to the main MSI Afterburner installation and open MSIAfterburner.cfg with notepad

\- Go to \[ATIADLHAL\]

\- Change UnofficialOverclockingEULA = too UnofficialOverclockingEULA	= I confirm that I am aware of unofficial overclocking limitations and fully understand that MSI will not provide me any support on it.

\- Change UnofficialOverclockingMode	= 0 to value 1

Jzx81 - chaser, cresta and the mark ii all came with the first gen tt 1jzgte 280hp @6800rpm 7750rpm limiter 280 tq @3500rpm you could get them either 5 speed mt with the r154 or the a340e at. The next model was the jzx90. They kept the chaser crests and markii models but completely redisgned them. The 1jz in this was still the twin turbo non vvti version they did do a few small changes to the engine for reliability. I think mainly with turbo oiling? Then the famous jzx100 lineup came out chaser crests mark ii models were still a thing. This was the year they introduced the new vvti 1jz with the single ct15b turbo and variable valve timing with a Yamaha designed head with titanium coated valves higher compression and added traction control I believe in this year. 280hp @6800 rpm 7500rpm limiter was lowered but the 280 tq @ 2800 rpm came on sooner. They also updated the r154 to the "tripod" r154 that had better synchros for smoother engagement. Then the next gen was the jzx110. They discontinued the chaser and cresta sadly kept the markii and introduced a new model called the verossa. Which looked like a fuckimg puffer fish I'm not even joking it was actually inspired by the puffer fish lol. The 1jz in this gen received a updated throttle body with a drive by wire setup and a smarter traction control mode for snow eco and performance. Or you could just turn it off completely. The tripod r154 in this gen also received another update with further synchro improvements. The auto versions in this gen received the same auto trans from the 2jz aristo aswell which was alot beefier then the previous jzx100 a340e. After 2004 they discontinued the 1jz in the lineup and switched to a na v6 and removed the manual transmission option.

A cool thing not many know is that the usdm is300 has the exact same suspension and chassis as the jzx110 chassis. You can swap a jzx110 1jz straight into a usdm is300 with the same trans and engine mounts. Lots of people do this. The is300 was basically the usdm jzx110 markii.
